snippet.title: Tileburg gameplay trailer
snippet.description:
Steam page : http://store.steampowered.com/app/4639170/Tileburg

Demo release : 1st of June
Release : 2026

Tileburg is an indie tile placement game that lets you build a medieval city. Place a variety of terrain and buildings on the landscape to score points. Each tile type has direct placement effects as well as powerful combos that can be triggered as soon as the conditions are right.

The twist : the city grows on its own! Each turn, the city expands onto a random tile, blocking certain spaces and triggering more combos.

This trailer is a first video and shows early game gameplay. This is not the definitive aspect of the game.  

No AI was used for the assets (music, sound effects, visuals, etc...).

Gameplay of Tileburg :
   • The continuous progression system allows you to unlock new tiles, larger kingdoms to play, and more
   • Increase your progression level and improve your highscore to reach the top of the player leaderboard
   • Optimize your game with special tiles
   • The effects and combos are hidden at the start. Discover them all as you play
   • More developed cities unlock new abilities that generate more points. Successfully developing your city in both size and density is crucial
   • Building cities is also part of the game's story. Your companion Kolak will help you with this task
   • Beautiful 2D tiles designed by a human
   • Create enchanting landscapes in a shimmering medieval fantasy world
